The sixth meeting of the National Steering Committee, NSE of PM Setu, today approved investment
plans worth around Rs 1,194 crore for five industrial training institute ITI clusters
across Maharashtra, Odisha and Jammu and Kashmir.
The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, MSDE said, the latest approvals have
taken the cumulative investment approved under Pradhan Mantri's killing and employability
transformation through upgraded ITI's PM Setu to more than Rs. 3,687 crore. Under the
PM Setu framework, the approved strategic investment plans will be implemented in collaboration
with state governments, industry partners and participating ITIs. We have a report.
The National Steering Committee has approved the strategic investment plan worth Rs. 240
crore-50 lakh for the ITI cluster in Orissa to Rs. 41 crore for the ITI cluster in
Pune and around 238 crore rupees for Chhatrapati-Sambhaji Nagar ITI cluster in Maharashtra.
Meanwhile, a strategic investment plan worth 240 crore rupees has been approved for the
Jammu ITI cluster and around 235 crore rupees for the Ashwinagar ITI cluster.
Addressing the meeting, MSDE secretary Devershri Mukherjee said that the approvers will
help strengthen ITIs, improve training and increase industry participation.
She noted that the progress made by Jammu and Kashmir is encouraging and reflects a strong
commitment to strengthening skilling and expanding opportunities for youth in the region.
Ms Mukherjee said that the aim is to improve training quality and help young people gain
skills that lead to better employment opportunities.
So, a measure in Akashwari News, Delhi.
Various traded associations across New Delhi have urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to
intervene to protect their livelihoods following heavy financial losses caused by recent protests.
In a joint letter written to the Prime Minister, the trade bodies highlighted that the protests
caused surrounding on the 10th of this month created an atmosphere of disruption and
panic scaring customers away from major markets for four to five days, both before
and after the event expressing concern over the ongoing festive season the
business bodies urged the Prime Minister the central government and the
judiciary to immediately ban all protests and marches in Delhi's
commercial hubs to safeguard the public and local economy. The trade bodies
demanded that financial damages be assessed and recovered directly from
protest organizers. Talking to media president of the Federation of
Lajpat Nagar Traders Association Kuldeep Arora said that the people of
entire Delhi are being inconvenienced due to the protests in Delhi.
The protests are causing significant losses and they are holding daily protests which
is affecting our business every day.
Preders in Delhi are suffering an estimated loss of 2000 crore rupees per day in business.
A letter has been written to the Honourable Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji.
The Supreme Court today said it will intervene if frequent protests and security restrictions
around cannot place a New Delhi adversely affected businesses.
A bench comprising Chief Justice of India, Surya Kant and Justice Joy Mala Bagchi was
hearing a plea challenging the New Delhi Municipal Council's decision to close Central Park
for two days ahead of a protest call by the cockroach Janata Party.

The central government informed the Supreme Court today that the rules to regulate
airfares pricing have been finalized and received administrative approval and would be published
within two weeks.
A bench of Justice Vikram Nath, Justice R. Mahadevan and Justice Aparich Singh was hearing
a PIL concerning arbitrary and exorbitant airfare pricing by the private airlines.
Solicitor-General Tushar Mehta informed the court that the rules had been finalized
and administrative approval had been granted for the publication.
Taking note of the submission, the court directed that the matter be listed on
16th of November by which date the published rules must be placed before it. This is Akashwani
giving you the news.
Welcome back to the news at 9. The Ministry of Home Affairs has introduced the Census Amendment
Amendment Rules 2026 under the Census Act 1948.
The Ministry issued a Gazette notification in this regard today.
The amendment revises the list of eligible enumerators to include teachers, government
officials, local authority staff and other persons considered suitable by the respective
state governments or union territory administrations.
Under the revised rules, teachers from government, local authority, aided and
unaided private educational institutions as well as institutions run by societies or
trust can be appointed as enumerators. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years

Jan Bhagidari, which means public participation, is a core governance model under Narendra Modi
government.
Schemes that utilize the Jan Bhagidari model include Swachh Bharat Mission, Catch the

The Embassy of India and Riyadh today advised Indian nationals in Saudi Arabia to continue
few following instructions issued by local authorities and remain indoors in the event
of an aerial attack. In a fresh advisory issued in view of the prevailing situation, the embassy
urged Indian nationals to refrain from filming, publishing or sharing any information, photographs
or videos related to the ongoing events. It also advised Indians planning to travel
to Saudi Arabia, including for Umrah, to take into account the ongoing disruptions
at Saudi airports and the possibility of flight cancellations, which could result
in extended stays. Meanwhile, Riyadh International Airport remains closed to flight operations,
while airports in Damam, Jeddah and Medina remain operational, although some disruptions continue.

The visit of UAE Foreign Minister will be an opportunity to review all facets of bilateral

Partnership.
Delegations will assess and take forward initiatives in the areas of energy, trade,
investments, fintech, defense and connectivity.
There will naturally be an opportunity also for a detailed exchange on the situation
The spokesperson said the external affairs minister will also hold talks with the U.S.

The spokesperson said that at the request of the government of Maldives, India has approved

23rd of October.
On the request of the government of Maldives, we have decided that we will carry out the

This currency swap arrangement is in place as for the agreement that was signed in
October of 2024. The present rollover will add to the financial stability of Maldives.
Today is Mahasashti marking the formal beginning of the Durga Puja festivities in the country.
West Bengal is immersed in festive spirit as beautifully decorated pandals, artistic
idols of Goddess Durga and vibrant cultural celebrations welcome devotees in the state.
People are coming together with great enthusiasm and devotion to celebrate the victory of
good over evil, spreading the message of unity, harmony and togetherness.

Benchmark domestic equity indices closed higher for the second consecutive session today.
The census rose 414 points or 0.56% to end at 74,729. The nifty climbed 149 points
for 0.65% to settle at 23,146. India's Komal has won a bronze medal in the women's 59 kilogram
category at the under-23 world wrestling championships at Las Vegas in the United States. Komal
defeated Kazakhstan's Victoria Kusaynova-72 in the bronze medal bout to finish third.
Another wrestler, Amruta Pujari, has entered the final of the women's 72 kilogram category
after securing two consecutive victories by pinfall, Amruta will face Ukraine's Irina
Zablotska in the gold medal bout.
Pujari began her campaign with a pinfall victory over Kazakhstan Sabira Zonova before defeating
China's Feng Shuiqui in the semifinal.
In badminton, India's Jagshe Singh Khangura has secured a bronze medal at the BWF World
Union Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
